manifest.title: Zero velocity. Nonzero acceleration.
manifest.summary: At the top, velocity is zero, but acceleration and gravitational force remain steady. Mass changes force, not motion.
manifest.description: Two side-by-side scenes show a vertical ball toss and its velocity-time graph. Learners can adjust launch speed, gravity, and mass to observe forces and motion.
assumptions: No air resistance, up is positive.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed or gravity, then press Play. Compare readings at the top.
